source_policy: Primary papers read beyond abstracts; no external code or trained weights downloaded.

sources.title: LoFTR: Detector-Free Local Feature Matching with Transformers
sources.math: Coarse correspondence followed by local fine matching; fine features are conditioned using coarse context.
sources.budget: Random initialization; separate ScanNet and MegaDepth training. ScanNet uses 230M sampled pairs, batch64 and approximately24hours on64GTX1080Ti GPUs. MegaDepth comprises about1M natural photographs.
sources.adoption: Separate alignment of broad geometry from scoring fine evidence. Do not import weights or claim the transformer architecture was reproduced.
sources.caveat: Local correspondence and pose benchmarks do not establish one-reference semantic-category recognition.

sources.title: Efficient LoFTR: Semi-Dense Local Feature Matching with Sparse-Like Speed
sources.math: Fine matching first selects mutual pixel correspondences, then refines within a3×3 neighborhood; this limits displacement from unrelated correlation peaks.
sources.budget: Coarse and fine modules trained jointly from scratch on natural MegaDepth images; batch16, approximately15hours on8V100 GPUs.
sources.adoption: Keep alignment search and local evidence scoring explicit; avoid averaging distant ambiguous peaks into an apparently precise match.
sources.caveat: Full-resolution output is fused from lower-resolution features; it is not a theorem that every input detail survives.

sources.title: R2D2: Repeatable and Reliable Detector and Descriptor
sources.math: Separate repeatability and descriptor reliability; ranking-derived reliability suppresses ambiguous local evidence.
sources.budget: Joint training from scratch:25epochs, batch8 pairs of192px crops. Three natural-image sources contribute roughly4000images each: web images, transformed Aachen images, and nearby Aachen view pairs with correspondence estimates. A localization variant also adds style-transferred night images.
sources.adoption: Do not treat a large, repeatable outline as automatically discriminative for a tiny-pattern decision.
sources.caveat: Its learned reliability is not equivalent to a heuristic interior mask; no pretrained descriptors are adopted.

sources.title: D2-Net: A Trainable CNN for Joint Description and Detection of Local Features
sources.math: Dense descriptors and detections share features; distinctive correspondences receive a detection-weighted triplet loss. Test-time dilated convolutions improve feature-grid resolution.
sources.budget: ImageNet-pretrained VGG16; only conv4_3 fine-tuned for50epochs. MegaDepth yields327036pairs, with18149validation pairs and118training scenes;100pairs per training scene per epoch.
sources.adoption: Descriptor discrimination and spatial localization are separate requirements. Compare native-detail preservation under identical proposals/alignment.
sources.caveat: The paper reports poorer accuracy at strict localization tolerances and a low-viewpoint-change training bias. Its pretrained weights violate this project’s external-weight constraint.

sources.title: Distinctive Image Features from Scale-Invariant Keypoints
sources.publication: International Journal of Computer Vision, 2004; author manuscript dated2004-01-05
sources.math: Locally normalized orientation descriptors, magnitude clipping and renormalization reduce dominant-gradient effects; nearest/second-nearest distance ratios reject ambiguous matches.
sources.budget: Handcrafted descriptors require no learned neural weights. Several constants were chosen empirically using image experiments; this is not an absence of designed priors or development data.
sources.adoption: Normalize fine-detail evidence separately instead of letting outline energy dominate; measure ambiguity relative to competing matches.
sources.caveat: A ratio to the next proposal can still accept a distinctive wrong object. It needs DEV calibration and explicit absent-target tests.

sources.title: Group Invariant Scattering
sources.math: Cascaded wavelet modulus transforms move high-frequency variation into stable coefficients before local averaging, under stated wavelet and deformation assumptions.
sources.budget: Mathematical construction, not an externally trained CNN. No one-shot natural-category benchmark is established by the theorem.
sources.adoption: Preserve a high-frequency channel before downsampling; stability should not be implemented by simply erasing the discriminative signal.
sources.caveat: Norm/stability results concern the specified scattering construction. They do not transfer automatically to truncated handcrafted filters or this proposed matcher; increasing invariance can remove orientation identity.
